question: Why is the manifold emanation rightly grounded in will?
premises: The universal emanation is indeed of will.
That emanation is established in many ways.
Therefore its having its own place is fitting.
inference: Because universal emanation proceeds from will, its manifold placement is coherent and justified.
plain_english: For the universal emanation is indeed of will and is established in many ways. Therefore its having its own proper place is fitting.
